evidence.text: Machine learning engineer at Halvorsen Compressors from August 2019 to May 2024, building failure-prediction models for industrial air compressors from vibration and temperature telemetry.
Recorded as model owner for the bearing-failure model in the company's model register from 2021; approved each retraining release (six between 2022 and 2024) and two changes to the alert threshold.

Built the telemetry ingestion pipeline that resamples controller data into ten-minute windows and writes the features to the analytics warehouse, with a daily completeness check on each controller's feed.
Reviewed the flagged alerts each month with two field-service engineers, recording whether the site inspection found bearing wear and adjusting the review list when an alert proved false.
Took part in a three-month trial that ran a compressed version of the model on two compressor controllers in the company's test hall.
